sections.title: Hi, we’re *Sheri and Vic*

image.alt: A spotted pointer wearing a shower cap and curlers, ready for a grooming day

body: We’re Sheri and Vic Scarborough, and we’re owned by several lovable adopted dogs. We’ve always loved animals, but have a special bond with the kind that bark.

Sheri has been part of the pet industry for 20 years, as a store owner, a sales representative and now a manufacturer, and she co-founded a dog rescue during our 10 years in Jacksonville, Florida. It’s still running today. Vic’s background is in corporate America, but you could say he has gone to the dogs.
We feel a real responsibility to help the dogs in our area, and we hold frequent fundraisers with rescue organizations. Stop by and say hello, and bring your best friend.
